observations.visible: One visually continuous upper cross-run joining the two rounded outer wings. Side descents curve inward into separated lower returns, leaving an open central lower gap.
observations.limits: Visual continuity is not proof of one seamless manufactured tube or absence of a hidden welded junction. Out-of-plane bow/radii and installed orientation not solved.

observations.visible: Dark rectangular plate with rounded lower corners hangs from upper tube center; two round holes visible side by side. Coated weld/attachment line visible along upper edge.
observations.limits: Plate thickness, hole bore/pitch, backside weld and relation to currentRDC downmember unknown; do not conflate with engine mounting plate or frame structure.

observations.visible: Tube end closed by shaped welded plate: broad rounded lower zone, stepped/offset bent neck and raised upper ear. Upper larger elongated/circular-in-perspective hole and lower smaller round opening genuinely visible.
observations.limits: No mm conversion, hidden face profile or generic flat solid cap adopted. Tiny dark spot below/left of lower opening may be coating/mark, not proven extra functional hole.

observations.visible: Opposite terminal plate shown mostly in side profile, with an offset/S-like bend, upper ear opening and welded attachment on tube.
observations.limits: Lower face/opening obscured by viewpoint. Do not certify a second lower hole or exact mirror from the first terminal. Photo left/right refers to image position, not a calibrated installed motorcycle side.

observations.visible: Dark radial round opening in each visible tube near terminal weld; coated irregular bead/meniscus at tube-to-plate joints.
observations.limits: Hole function (vent/drain/manufacturing/fastener), exact diameters, wall thickness, joint process/strength and hidden bead extent unknown. No painted highlight tracing as topology.

observations.visible: OfficialRDC shows separate external dark guard wings ahead of engine; front view center is hidden by fork, feature close-up exposes part of a mounting plate and fastener region.
observations.limits: Neither all upper continuity nor lower hidden mounting interfaces proven forRDC. PF231201 linked topology fits the visible family, not exact market/year certificate.
